verdict.rationale: Kimi documents autonomous multi-step agent work. Kimi Code's agent can read code, edit files, run commands and "autonomously complete development tasks". The consumer app also lists an agent mode with Agent clusters, "Agent tasks", scheduled tasks and deep research. However, the evidence is mostly help-index headings: nothing shows the task running asynchronously in the background while the user is away, or a hand-back step where results are presented for review. Missing for 10: documented background/asynchronous execution of delegated tasks, an explicit review/approval hand-back flow, in-depth first-party docs beyond index titles, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended delegation.
